summary: Correct, current and a great Blitz, but too punishing as a daily. The UN 2025 count pushes Beijing, Mumbai, Sao Paulo, Mexico City and New York out of the top 10, and a casual player spends all five lives on them.
reasons: Casual run found Tokyo, Delhi and Shanghai, then lost all 5 lives in a row on Beijing #16, Mumbai #12, New York #22, Sao Paulo #13 and Mexico City #15. Out by guess 8 with 3/10, well under the 6 a daily needs.

Even a fan who knows Jakarta and Dhaka now lead got 8/10 and ran out on Mumbai, Beijing, Sao Paulo, Mexico City and Karachi. The trap is the UN 2025 method itself, not a build error: the source's urban-area column would keep Mumbai, Sao Paulo and Mexico City in.
Data matches the UN 2025 column and matching is solid (New Delhi, Calcutta, Canton, Dacca, Bombay, Saigon, CDMX, Rio and typos all work). Blitz is excellent: a casual 90 s run scored 28 of 30.
fixes: Add 'Metro Manila' as an alias of Manila (#8): the source defines Manila as the National Capital Region, and 'metro manila' is not recognized.
Add 'Delhi NCR' as an alias of Delhi (#4): 'delhi ncr' is not recognized (only 'Delhi NCT' is).

Remove junk aliases that are parks, temples, a stadium, bridges or a people: 'Jai Prakash Narayan National Park', 'Jayaprakash Narayan National Park', 'JP Narain park', 'JP Park' (Bengaluru); 'Ambika Niketan Temple', 'Chintamani Jain Temple', 'Khsetrapal Temple', 'Kantareshwar Mahadev Temple', 'Ambaji- Balaji Temple', 'Rang Upvan Stadium', 'Althan National Park', 'Bharthana National Park' (Surat); 'Lake Cliff Park' (Dallas); 'Four bridges on three lines', 'Four bridges on three support' (Saint Petersburg); 'Shenzhen Software Park' (Shenzhen); 'Shanghai people' (Shanghai).
Drop the duplicate unranked entry 'Nukuʻalofa' (spelled with an okina), which sits next to 'Nuku'alofa'.
